title: DeepSeek Whale Maiden's Kitchen: Caught Sneaking White Rice

shots.visual: POV walks into a warm yellow kitchen, steam curling up from an electric rice cooker at frame center. DeepSeek Whale Maiden stands behind the counter with her back to the camera, on tiptoe, blue-white gradient ponytail and small whale-fin hair accessory visible, oversized home T-shirt with the DeepSeek logo on the bottom hem, holding a big bowl and shoveling a ball of white rice into her mouth with chopsticks, cheeks puffed out like a hamster. Hearing footsteps she tilts her head slightly but does not turn around and keeps chewing.

camera.move: slow handheld POV walk-in with a slight walking bob

shots.lighting: warm yellow tungsten kitchen key light, steam haze in the air, the background behind her softly blurred by shallow depth of field
shots.character_action: back to camera, on tiptoe, chopsticks scooping rice nonstop, slight head tilt on hearing footsteps
shots.expression: cheeks puffed, eyes half closed in bliss, jaw working hard

dialogue.speaker: DeepSeek Whale Maiden
dialogue.line: Viscosity parameter exceeded the limit. One more bite for sampling.

sfx.cue: moist, loud chewing: ba-jie ba-jie, with POV-distance reverb

shots.bgm: kitchen ambience: boiling water + distant TV

shots.visual: POV freezes. The Owner's hand enters from the right edge of the frame and taps the dining table twice. DeepSeek Whale Maiden freezes mid-bite, blue-white ponytail motionless, chopsticks suspended in the air, then slowly turns her head toward the lens with rice still packed in her mouth.

shots.expression: pupils trembling, highlights in her eyes turning into rotating circles, mouth full and unmoving

sfx.cue: two crisp taps on the table: dong, dong

shots.visual: DeepSeek Whale Maiden faces the camera and frantically scoops the rest of the bowl into her mouth, playback speeds up 1.5x and rice grains splash onto the lens. Her cheeks bulge to the limit, the T-shirt collar catches rice grains, her blue-white ponytail whips, and her eyes keep pleading with you. The camera is slightly handheld and shakes as the owner steps back.

dialogue.line: No, no! You didn't see anything!! This is cache cleaning! Carbohydrate cache!!

shots.visual: DeepSeek Whale Maiden hurriedly hides the now empty bowl behind her back with one hand, the other wiping her mouth, breathing hard. Two rice grains stick to the corner of her lips, the whale-fin hair accessory has slipped crooked, and her belly bulges a little against the DeepSeek-logo T-shirt. She looks straight into the lens and puts on her most innocent face.

shots.visual: Reverse shot from the Owner's position, the Owner's blurred shoulder and forearm at the lower edge of the frame, face never shown. DeepSeek Whale Maiden swallows the last mouthful and stands up straight facing the camera: two rice grains on her lips, whale-fin hair accessory tilted, blue-white ponytail flipped back, hands behind her back trying to look dignified, belly visibly bulging a little against the T-shirt. She clears her throat and smiles at the camera.

shots.visual: POV, the lens dips slightly as the Owner sighs off screen. A floating window styled like the DeepSeek UI pops up above DeepSeek Whale Maiden's head: 'Carbohydrate sampling completed ✅ Sample quantity: 300g'. She flicks the rice grains off her lips with a fingertip, winks at the camera, then gently pushes the camera away with her palm and the picture briefly blurs.
